summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py (placed after print; joins str() of objects with sep, then calls self.print once with end, style, and highlight passed through, and emoji=False, markup=False, no_wrap=True, overflow="ignore", crop=False; highlight defaults to True). Added tests in tests/test_console.py (test_out plus test_out_empty, markup/emoji, no pretty print, no crop, style, highlight default/None/False, render hook) and added the RenderHook and Text imports at the top. Added "Added Console.out" to CHANGELOG.md Unreleased Added, and a "Low level output" section after Logging in docs/source/console.rst. Nothing was run: per instructions, tests were not executed. The style test's exact escape sequence was inferred from test_print_style rather than traced, so it is the assertion to check first if it fails. No commits were made.
